children: UBS Group AG (NYSE:UBS) plans to meet Swiss rules—mixing 50% CET1/50% AT1 funding and an 11% CET1 payout trigger—estimating ~$13bn AT1 needs and ~$1bn annual cost, while selling options tied to Nasdaq Gold, Silver and WTI FLOWSTM and expanding with John Hall’s Bellevue team.
: Swiss committees propose UBS can fund foreign units with 50% CET1/50% AT1, set 11% CET1 trigger halting payouts. UBS says it needs about $13bn AT1, ~ $1bn yearly cost at 8%.
: UBS sold options tied to Nasdaq Gold FLOWSTM 103, Silver FLOWSTM 106 and WTI Crude Oil FLOWSTM 106 on Aug 17, 2026. It expects cash distributions and possible coupon declarations on Sep 14, 2026.
: UBS Group AG adds Financial Advisor John Hall and The Hall Wealth Management Group in Bellevue, WA. Team brings 21 years' client experience and joins UBS Pacific Northwest market team.
